name: Libre-Closet
description: A free, open-source, self-hosted wardrobe organizer. Catalog your clothes, upload photos, build outfits, and access everything from your phone as an offline-ready PWA — all on your own server.

variables.name: PWA Enabled
variables.description: Enable or disable PWA service worker.

variables.name: Auth Access Token
variables.description: Secret key for signing access tokens. Generate a secure random key with `openssl rand -base64 60`

variables.name: Email From Address
variables.description: Email address to use as the sender for password reset emails.

variables.name: Email Transport
variables.description: Email transport method to use for sending emails.

variables.name: Mailgun API Key
variables.description: API key for Mailgun email transport.

variables.name: Internal Data Path
variables.description: Internal data path. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Database Type
variables.description: Type of database to use (e.g., sqlite, postgres). Not recommended to change.

variables.name: File Storage Type
variables.description: Type of file storage to use (e.g., local, s3). Not recommended to change.
